title: In SUMMARIZECOLUMNS, ALLSELECTED doesn't restore a NONVISUAL filter: the visual total is every product's

source.quote: Returns the result where [Visual Total Sales] is the total across all years
source.supports: the page's NONVISUAL example: the filter of the group-by column picks the rows, and CALCULATE ( [Sales], ALLSELECTED ( the column ) ) is the total without that filter; without NONVISUAL it is the total of the selected years

source.quote: Marks a value filter in SUMMARIZECOLUMNS as not affecting measure values, but only applying to group-by columns.
source.supports: the NONVISUAL filter still picks which products are rows

derivation: The rows are the products the filter leaves: Bike and Lock. Bike: Sales rows 1, 5, 7 = 100 + 200 + 100 = 400. Lock: rows 4, 6 = 50 + 30 = 80. ALLSELECTED removes the filter of the row and, the selection being non-visual, restores no filter on Product: every sale, 540 (as Learn's example gives the total across all years). Compare allselected/visual-total-in-summarizecolumns, 480 without NONVISUAL.
